newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Hotels buys 50pct of Conrad Hotel HK.
newsitem.headline: Sino Hotels buys 50pct of Conrad Hotel HK.

text.p: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Ltd said it had reached a conditional agreement to buy 50 percent of Greenroll Ltd, a Hong Kong-based company which owns the Conrad Hotel in Pacific Place, Hong Kong, for about HK$1.1 billion.
It said Blinco Enterprises Ltd and Mersey Ltd had agreed to sell their 50 percent stake in the issued share capital of Greenroll. The acquisition is expected to be mainly financed by bank borrowings.
Sino Hotels said it has paid an initial deposit of HK$50 million and will pay 25 percent of the total consideration on completion, which is due to take place on December 31.
The balance will be paid on January 31, 1997.
The vendors are related to Taiwan's Pacific Electric Wire & Cable Co Ltd, the announcement said.
The Conrad Hotel has 513 guest rooms, 10 function rooms, a business centre and restaurants. Greenroll had net profit of about HK$53.2 million in 1995.
Completion of the agreement requires approval from other Greenroll shareholders and banks.
The hotel is part of the Conrad chain under Hilton Hotels Corp and Ladbroke Group.
